categories.main_business_segments: DXC operates through two primary segments: Global Business Services (GBS) and Global Infrastructure Services (GIS). GBS focuses on analytics and engineering, applications, and business process services, while GIS provides cloud and security, IT outsourcing, and modern workplace solutions. These segments deliver a broad range of IT services and solutions to help clients transform and manage their operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: DXC leverages advanced technologies such as cloud computing, data analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, and cybersecurity. The company employs modern software engineering, agile process automation, and IT outsourcing, with a focus on integrating and optimizing both legacy and modern IT environments. DXC also utilizes a global delivery model, including significant offshore capabilities, to provide scalable and cost-effective solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: DXC serves a diverse customer base, including nearly half of the Fortune 500, across industries such as public sector, insurance, banking and capital markets, automotive, and commercial enterprises of various sizes. The company’s solutions address mission-critical IT needs for both private and public sector organizations worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: DXC operates in approximately 70 countries, with key markets in the United States, United Kingdom, other parts of Europe, Australia, and other international regions. The company maintains a significant presence in EMEA, APAC, and the Americas, with a global workforce and delivery centers in both onshore and offshore locations.
categories.supply_chain_position: DXC operates as a downstream IT services provider, delivering end-to-end technology solutions directly to enterprise and public sector clients. The company manages and integrates technology from hardware, software, and cloud partners, acting as a systems integrator and managed services provider rather than a manufacturer or upstream supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: DXC’s strategic priorities include strengthening customer relationships, optimizing costs, expanding offerings across the enterprise technology stack, and driving innovation in digital transformation, cloud migration, and cybersecurity. The company invests in R&D to develop differentiated services in analytics, automation, cloud, and modern workplace, while also pursuing portfolio rationalization and selective acquisitions and divestitures to align with its strategic direction.
categories.revenue_model: DXC generates revenue primarily through long-term service contracts, including time and materials, unit price, and fixed-price agreements, as well as software sales and managed services. The company also earns revenue from business process outsourcing, cloud migration, and IT infrastructure management, with some contracts including performance-based or volume-based pricing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: DXC faces competition from large multinational IT services firms (such as Accenture, IBM, and Tata Consultancy Services), specialized service providers, offshore firms (notably from India), and in-house IT departments of large corporations. The company positions itself as a global leader in mission-critical IT services, emphasizing its scale, breadth of offerings, and experience in managing complex enterprise environments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended March 31, 2022, DXC reported revenues of $16.3 billion, with operations in approximately 70 countries and a workforce of over 130,000 employees. The company experienced an 8.3% year-over-year revenue decline, reflecting recent divestitures and project completions, but improved profitability and cash flow through cost optimization and restructuring. DXC continues to focus on stabilizing revenue and strengthening its financial foundation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DXC’s value proposition centers on its ability to deliver mission-critical IT services at scale, modernize legacy systems, and drive digital transformation for large enterprises. The company differentiates itself through its global reach, deep industry expertise, end-to-end service capabilities, and focus on security, reliability, and operational excellence. DXC emphasizes its role as a trusted partner for complex, large-scale IT environments.
